weight: There is no weight figure anywhere in the bank, so there is nothing to chart. What it says instead: the load on a goods carriage is whatever the permit allows (Q190), an axle-weight limit is posted on a sign (Q86), section 113 of the Act forbids exceeding the permitted weight (Q200), and overloading of any kind costs at least ₹2000 and can cost you the licence (Q191, Q137, Q415).
